description: Run the Nemesis Learn agent locally to exercise every route of your app in dev/staging so the Shield baseline finishes in minutes instead of waiting on real traffic. Then call nemesis_approve_routes and nemesis_set_mode enforce. Needs the app token (nsk_) — pass appToken or set NEMESIS_TOKEN in the env.

appToken.description: The app's nsk_ token (defaults to the NEMESIS_TOKEN env var)

repo.description: Path to the app's repo so Learn can discover routes from source

target.description: Base URL of the running app, e.g. http://localhost:3000

name: nemesis_run_learn
